info.title: Hermes Enterprise Platform API
info.description: Hermes enterprise platform MVP API. Authentication is JWT Bearer. Chat preserves the stateful session contract; the default local provider is a compatibility mock and the pinned Hermes HTTP adapter is enabled only for a private deployment.
